Mihomo v1.19.31, commit ab405bad5beeeac8b003bb01f60f134f6df54471.
Native source adapter and build instructions: tools/native/mihomo-core and
scripts/ci/build-libxray-mihomo-android.ps1 in the Nimbo source workspace.
This Android beta embeds Mihomo in the existing LibXray Go runtime.
Exact original source module pins are in pins.json. The source license manifest
is the adapter module inventory, not a merged APK dependency inventory.
The only protobuf source alteration is the documented go.mod directive patch.
Mihomo license and dependency notices are in licenses/. Full Android integration
limitations are documented in the app and accompanying build report.
